capabilities: : Display files as syntax-highlighted code blocks
: Automatically switch files to reading view
intentEvidence: This plugin now implements a complete 2-in-1 solution with both file extension registration and syntax highlighting.
problem: Obsidian does not natively support syntax highlighting for custom or non-standard file extensions, resulting in unformatted code blocks in reading view.

relations.evidence: Built upon the foundation of MeepTech/obsidian-custom-file-extensions-plugin for file extension registration.

summary: Custom Syntax Highlights displays files with custom extensions as syntax-highlighted code blocks in reading view using configurable extension-to-language mappings.
